mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 54 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park.

The city of Verona has updated its list of polling locations with two new sites added last September. To find out if your voting ward has moved, visit the My Vote Wisconsin website before heading out to the polls, which remain open from 7 AM to 8 PM on election day.

We have plenty of action this week. Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness, Art House 360 festivities, or Trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow brings live music to Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, with the Dane County Farmers' Market and live music at Paddy Mac's following this Saturday.
In a report covering the week of October 5 to October 12, officers handled several incidents, including a motor vehicle crash on October 7 involving an electric motorcycle on Basswood Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough. The local Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM so be sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
